:::{#exm-monomial-degree}
#### Degrees of some monomials

- $x_1^3 x_4$ has [degree](#def-monomial-degree) $3 + 1 = 4$.
- $x_2^2 x_3^5$ has degree $2 + 5 = 7$.
- The [constant](#def-constant-function) [monomial](#def-monomial) $1$ has degree $0$.
- With one variable, the monomial $x^n$ has degree $n$,
  which is the [degree](#def-polynomial-degree) of the one-term [polynomial](#def-polynomial) $f(x) = x^n$.

:::
